models.label: CX60 · published topology
models.description: 60 representative central-complex model populations and all 326 published directed edges, explored with simplified deterministic rates.
models.biological_basis: Pisokas, Heinze and Webb (eLife 2020) anatomy-constrained Drosophila heading-circuit MODEL topology and optimized connection strengths. Not an EM-derived connectome.
approximations: Representative populations aggregate anatomical cells; no individual neuron IDs.
Published 62 × 62 matrix has 60 connected units and 2 all-zero padding entries. Interface has 64 slots; unused 4 remain zero.
Dynamics are our rectified fixed-point rate relaxation, not the paper's LIF or tanh-current dynamics.
Global strength gain 1/100 and Q10 rounding are chosen engineering approximations.
Triangular 90-degree half-width cue and unitless P-EN-A/B turn drive are synthetic.
No calibrated yaw sign, path integration, self-sustained attractor or biological behavior validation.
Activity decays after cue removal. Seed has no effect: zero initial state, deterministic and noiseless.
No full brain, fly organism, consciousness or watch-sensor calibration is represented.

models.raw_strength_source: Exact published category-to-strength mapping from collect_stats_long_run.m; strengths are fitted MODEL values, not synapse counts.
models.edge_semantics: raw_weight is absolute published model strength; sign is published model sign; denominator 100 is global adaptation gain divisor; weight_q is signed implemented Q10 coefficient.
models.rounding: round(published_signed_strength*1024/100), nearest with half away from zero
models.readout: Strongest mean E-PG sector, 45-degree resolution; duplicate 0-degree units are averaged. Lowest-angle sector wins ties. -1 means no E-PG activity. Not a calibrated compass.

provenance.name: Pisokas2020 Drosophila heading circuit: 60 connected representative model units
provenance.source_license: MIT; see LICENSE. Copyright (c) 2020 Kyobi S. Kakaria, Benjamin L. de Bivort and Ioannis Pisokas
provenance.orientation: upstream matrix[target,source]; source driver transposes before calling simulator
provenance.strength_evidence: collect_stats_long_run.m lines395-433; these are fitted MODEL strengths, not synapse counts
derivation: Map category labels through published parameter set
No pruning, random replacement, or invented neurons
limitations: Representative model units collapse multiple anatomical cells
Anatomical overlap motivated wiring; connection strengths were optimized
No measured fly membrane dynamics or real watch-sensor calibration
No whole-brain, consciousness, organism or biological-equivalence claim
Deterministic fixed-point rate adaptation is a new dynamics model unless equivalence is demonstrated
provenance.cue_mapping: EPG34..42 and43..51 each use [0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315,0] degrees from upstream cue code; model-relative, not compass calibrated
provenance.pen_half_convention: A=0..7;B=8..15; upstream comments disagree on hemisphere naming; establish rotation sign empirically
